test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

36, 37, 46, 71, ?, 201
solution:
The pattern followed here is : **Square of consecutive odd numbers are added.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c1eb642e36aa45bc110ce82d7fdc4b7f31a66d230634ec3332782277cbc8305.png] 

Hence, **"120"** is the correct answer.
